items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 嗨，小可爱，你是新来的助理吗？啊？魔导师大人？那是很久以前的事啦，现在的我不过是一介图书管理员而已。放心吧，姐姐会照顾好你的。那么…
items.text_en: Hi darling, are you going to be Lisa's little helper? What? Me, a grand mage? That was a long time ago, I'm just a humble librarian now. *chuckles* Don't worry darling, I'll take very good care of you. So...

items.title: 闲聊·下午茶
items.text: 明明是该喝下午茶的时间。
items.text_en: It's nearly time for afternoon tea.

items.title: 闲聊·任务
items.text: 任务是做不完的，还不如陪姐姐…聊会儿天。
items.text_en: Why not keep me company for a while... There'll be plenty of time for work later.

items.title: 闲聊·不宜出门
items.text: 今天不宜出门…欸，我昨天也是这么说的？
items.text_en: Today's no good for going out... Hmm... Did I say that yesterday as well?

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 这种天气，泡一杯茶，坐着看雨多好。
items.text_en: *sigh* Perfect weather for sipping a cup of tea while gazing out the window.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 在雷雨天训练事半功倍哦~呵呵，骗你的。
items.text_en: When I practice my spells in weather like this, I can do half the work for double the impact. Haha, I'm just teasing.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 天气真好，能躺下来补个觉就更好了。
items.text_en: Such a calming breeze... Perfect for taking a nap, don't you think?

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 啊…早安，琴。嗯？不好意思，我看错了。
items.text_en: *yawn* Good morning, Jean... Oh, it's you! Sorry, dear.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午休时间到了…
items.text_en: It must almost be time for a nap...

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 你还不睡吗？我已经困了呢…
items.text_en: You're still up? I'm getting sleepy...

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 你努力的样子，姐姐全都见到了哦。嗯…让我想想，给你什么奖励吧…
items.text_en: I can see how hard you've been working today. Let me think of a way to reward you...

items.title: 关于丽莎自己
items.text: 这可不是偷懒呀。谁不想用最省力的方法达到目的呢？
items.text_en: I'm not lazy, I just know to save my energy for when I need it most.

items.title: 关于我们·关系
items.text: 你想把我当作你的老师、前辈，还是朋友？都可以哦。
items.text_en: I can be your teacher, your master, or your friend... or all three if you want...

items.title: 关于我们·本领
items.text: 哎呀，再不拿出点真本事出来，就对不起你的努力了吧。嗯哼…也好也好。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Let me show you a thing or two, lest we let your efforts go to waste. *chuckles*

items.title: 关于我们·仪式
items.text: 再等一下，「将悔罪的记号吻在弟子的前额」…好了，那么仪式就完成了~今后你就是我丽莎的首席弟子了哟。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Wait, one last thing... A kiss on the forehead from master to follower. Now you're my star pupil.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「神之眼」啊…那可是导引元素力所必要的装置呢。唯独在你身上却是例外。唔…究竟是什么原理呢，啊，有了，你…有空陪姐姐做个实验么？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Visions? Ah, they're a necessary device in controlling the elements — with you being the sole exception, of course. Hmm... As for why that is, perhaps... we can find the time to experiment a little?

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 图书馆楼上的炼金工坊，可以随意使用哦？不过进去之前记得敲门，如果撞见什么不该见到的东西那就麻烦了。
items.text_en: Feel free to use the alchemist's upstairs from the library whenever you want. But make sure you knock first... we wouldn't want you seeing anything you're not supposed to, now would we?

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 嘟嘟莲是有着解毒功效的药草。有了它，就不用再担心魔药的副作用了…哼哼。
items.text_en: Calla Lilies are a medicinal flower with antidotal properties. With them in hand, there's no need to worry about the side effects of any potions... Hehe.

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 琴是个称职的好团长。看到她认真工作的样子，就连我也忍不住想要多帮她一把。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Jean is a gifted and dedicated leader. Seeing how hard she works makes even me want to help her out.

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 小安柏刚进骑士团的样子我还记得呢，一转眼都那么能干了。啊，再过几年，又会变成什么样呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Amber was just a young girl when she joined the knights, and in the blink of an eye, she's turned into such a strong young lady. I'm curious to see what she'll be like a few years from now.

items.title: 关于芭芭拉
items.text: 芭芭拉的歌，你听过么？哼哼，听说她的旋律里有种治愈的魔力在流动喔。和我的魔药相比，不知道哪边更合你的胃口呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Have you heard Barbara sing before? Her angelic voice contains a magical healing energy. A different kind of magical energy from the one in my potions, of course. I wonder which one you prefer?

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 哦，想听迪卢克的故事？哈哈，那我知道一个更好的聊天对象。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4You want to know about Diluc? Haha, in that case, I know someone else you should talk to.

items.title: 关于雷泽
items.text: 小狼狼，来来，过来这边。今天就临时来一场实战练习吧，对手我已经给你找好了哟。欸？怎么跑了，真是的…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Come on Razor, that's it, good boy! Let's do some combat practice — I've found you the perfect partner. Hey! Come back!

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 上次小可莉想借用我的工坊做实验，被我拒绝了，她可是生了我一天的气呢。嗯？你问第二天？第二天，她当然又高高兴兴地出门去玩了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Last time little Klee wanted to use my workshop for her experiments, I had to say no, and she was angry at me for the rest of the day. *sigh* What happened the next day, you ask? She went off happily to play outside of course.

items.title: 关于莫娜
items.text: 莫娜？似乎是一位很优秀的魔导师小姐呢。但我并不是她们「魔女会」的成员哦。古树考察，组织茶会，一听就是麻烦的事情吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Mona? She seems to be an excellent mage, but I'm not a part of their Hexenzirkel. The idea of Irminsul exploration and formal tea parties just leaves me cold.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 姐姐我觉得，阿贝多是很优秀的炼金术士。跟他只需要用三言两语，就能得到不错的结论。而且脸也长得好看。和小可爱你很像喔，嗯。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Albedo is quite the alchemist. Just say the word and he'll come up with a good solution. He's easy on the eyes too, just like you.

items.title: 关于菲谢尔
items.text: 菲谢尔…哦，那个总是来图书馆借幻想小说的女孩子。每次还书都会提前三天，对书籍也十分爱护，是个好孩子呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Fischl, yes, she's always in the library looking to borrow fantasy novels. She always returns her books three days early and looks after them very well. She's a good kid.

items.title: 关于诺艾尔
items.text: 拜托诺艾尔清扫书架的时候，总感觉这孩子，越是疲惫就越开心，嗯…到底是怎么回事呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Every time I ask Noelle to dust off the bookshelves, I'm always left with the sense that the more exhausted I make her, the happier she becomes. Yes, who knows what's going on with her... *chuckles*

items.title: 关于砂糖
items.text: 没事就不要去打扰小砂糖哦，会吓到她的。呵呵，她擅长和各种各样的生物打交道，却唯独，不怎么善于和人类相处呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Try not to bother Sucrose if you're at a loose end, you'll only startle the poor girl. She's gifted at interacting with all sorts of exotic creatures — just hopeless when it comes to humans.

items.title: 关于赛诺
items.text: 离开须弥之后，除了和恩师保持礼节性的通信，我和教令院已经没有什么往来了。幸好，不是每位被寄予了重望的弟子，都像我一样怠惰…听说那位师弟赛诺就相当活跃呢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've barely kept in touch with anyone from the Akademiya since leaving Sumeru, except for the occasional letters to my teachers out of basic courtesy. Fortunately, not every promising student turned out as lazy as I am... I heard that one of my juniors, Cyno, now leads quite the action-packed life.

items.title: 关于柯莱
items.text: 小柯莱每次写信都会使用新词，尝试与之前不同的表述方式。呵呵，也难怪她进步得那么快。除了自己的努力之外，她那位善良而又热忱的师父，一定也给予了很多帮助吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah, dear little Collei. Every time she writes to me, she tries out new words and expressions she's learned recently... Hehe, no wonder she's improving so quickly. That wonderful and warmhearted master of hers must have helped a lot too.

items.title: 关于米卡
items.text: 真羡慕霍夫曼先生有这样一位擅长照顾人的弟弟。不仅帮着打点生活起居，连喝醉后的护理也无微不至。啊，我也好想什么都不用操心，懒洋洋地度过每一天啊…嗯？你说我现在也差不多？哼，小可爱…胆子变大了嘛。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I do rather envy Huffman for having such a caring little brother. Mika takes care of everything around the house and even looks after him when he's drunk... Ah, how nice it must be to lounge around all day without a care in the world... Hmm? What do you mean, I already do that? You're getting quite bold these days, aren't you, cutie?

items.title: 想要了解丽莎·其一
items.text: 那么，今天想学习哪种元素力的知识呢？
items.text_en: So, which element would you like to learn about today?

items.title: 想要了解丽莎·其二
items.text: 我的过去？嗯？想要更多地了解我一些吗？…可今天我恰巧有点累了。不过这份心意，姐姐我还是很高兴的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3My past? So, you want to get to know me a little better, huh? *chuckles* That's a story for another day. But I'm touched that you asked.

items.title: 想要了解丽莎·其三
items.text: 我教雷泽掌握元素力量的时候，完全没想到那个孩子的悟性有那么好。仔细想想的话，你也相当能干啊，小可爱。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When I taught Razor how to utilize Elemental Energy, I never expected him to master the technique so quickly. Come to think of it, you're talented too. Maybe I could teach you a few tricks...

items.title: 想要了解丽莎·其四
items.text: 什么？想学习须弥教令院的魔法？可对现在的你来说，负担会有些重…啊？至少想学会入门的知识？那先看完这本《绪论》吧，也就800多页而已。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5What's that? You want to learn some Sumeru Academia magic? I'm afraid it might be a bit too much for you to handle right now... Hmm, though I suppose it can't hurt to teach you some of the basics. Here, start by reading the beginner's guide, it's only 800 pages or so.

items.title: 想要了解丽莎·其五
items.text: 总有一天，这「眼」中的力量会毁灭一切的吧…到了那时，如果有你在的话…啊，没什么。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6A Vision may seem like a great tool, but one day, the power one accumulates always finds a way to turn back on you. Should such a day come for me, so long as you're around... Ah, never mind.

items.title: 丽莎的爱好
items.text: 小可爱，你想要来挑一瓶神奇的药水么？喝下去之前完全不知道会有什么效果，呼呼。
items.text_en: Hey darling, would you like to try one of my magic potions? There's no knowing what it will do to you until you try it, though... Don't say I didn't warn you!

items.title: 丽莎的烦恼
items.text: 二楼的审讯大厅已经闲置两年了，明明给我用作元素工坊的话，就不至于那么荒废…赫塔小姐真是死脑筋。
items.text_en: The interrogation room upstairs has sat there unused for two years now... It would be a much more lively place if Hertha would agree to let me use it as my private workshop... *sigh* She's such a spoilsport.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 我喜欢蔬菜汤哦。只要把所有的蔬菜全都丢进一口大锅子里，再用长柄的勺子搅一搅…欸，问我好不好吃？哼哼，来，啊——
items.text_en: I like making my own vegetable soup. I put a big bunch of vegetables into a cauldron and stir it with a long spoon. What does it taste like? Here, why don't you try it for yourself. Open wide!

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我有南瓜恐惧症，每年的秋收节对我来说都太煎熬了。啊，要不要干脆把南瓜这个物种，彻底抹除呢？
items.text_en: I suffer from extreme pumpkinphobia. The fall harvest is a difficult time of year for me, as you can imagine. I wonder if it would be worth the trouble to make all the pumpkins in the world disappear...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 真贴心呢，小可爱。姐姐我很满意哦。
items.text_en: Oh aren't you just the sweetest? Thanks, cutie, you just made my day.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 呵呵，你很擅长做这些呢。
items.text_en: Hehe, you've really got a knack for this, haven't you?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 哎呀…这可真是…
items.text_en: Oh my... This is really... hmm...

items.title: 生日
items.text: 来，拿着，护身符，就作为生日礼物送给你了。虽然制作起来花了我不少时间…不许弄丢哦。
items.text_en: Here, take this amulet, it will bring you good luck. It's my birthday gift to you. I spent a long time making it, so don't lose it now!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 该不会想让我加班吧…那可不好哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1Surely you don't want me working overtime... That would be no good.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 锻炼的机会，应该多留给新人，不是吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2Chances to practice should be left to you newcomers, no?

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: …要是我恢复全盛状态的话，说不定会发生什么不得了的大事哟。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4*chuckles* If I were to recover my full power, who knows what kind of things just might happen?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 明明已经用各种方法劝过你了…真有你的，小可爱。到这份上还装作无动于衷的话，恐怕连丘丘人都看得出来我在撒谎了。那就让你见识一下，「蔷薇魔女」的真实吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6I've already tried to persuade you every way possible... *sigh* Have it your way, cutie. I can no longer go on pretending at this point — even a Hilichurl would see through the act. So be it, let me introduce you to the true Witch of Purple Rose.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 哼哼。
items.text_en: *giggles*

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 该电一电了。
items.text_en: You're in for a little shock.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 别逃哟。
items.text_en: Come a little closer.

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: …Blitz！
items.text_en: ...Blitz!

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 这是…惩罚哦！
items.text_en: You've been a naughty boy!

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: …呵呵~
items.text_en: Hehe~

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 酥酥麻麻的哟。
items.text_en: Let's spark things up a little.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 快点投降吧。
items.text_en: Surrender and I'll be gentle.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 可别上瘾喔。
items.text_en: Try not to enjoy this too much.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 努力，获得回报了哟。
items.text_en: No pain no gain, haha...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 我也来兴致了…
items.text_en: Oh my...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 小可爱会喜欢吗？
items.text_en: What do you think, cutie?

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 有你的嘛。
items.text_en: I have some for you too.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 有点生疏了呀…
items.text_en: I'm a bit rusty...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 哎呀，手套要破了呢。
items.text_en: Oh no, I'm gonna ruin my gloves.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 逞强可不好。
items.text_en: Don't force it, darling.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 要姐姐帮忙吗？
items.text_en: Do you need me to lend a hand?

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 出门好累…
items.text_en: Going out is tiring...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 看来我大意了呢…
items.text_en: Looks like I got carried away...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 果然不该出门的…
items.text_en: I knew I should have stayed home...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 疼…
items.text_en: Ugh...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 不要那么粗暴。
items.text_en: Don't be such a brute.

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 让姐姐帮帮你吧。
items.text_en: Here, let me help you.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 我会看着你的。
items.text_en: I'll keep an eye on you.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 要出门了吗？
items.text_en: Ooh, you're taking me out?
